mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the cost of capital and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate to below 4.0% signals a tight labor market, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE falls below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of industrial production above 100 (2017=100) and unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a strong economic expansion, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 100 and UNRATE < 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), a decline in industrial production to below 95 (2017=100) signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 95 during a monetary tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of residential construction (HOUST) above 550 thousand units is associated with strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of the absolute level.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for HOUST over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03, or the average 20-day forward return when HOUST is in the top 25% of historical values is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in residential construction below 500 thousand units signals weak housing demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 500.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of residential sales above 400,000 million dollars and unemployment rate below 4.0% signals strong economic growth, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS > 400000 and UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals an early monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5.
